name: Divi Form Styler for CF7, Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms
author: DiviEpic

sections.description:
Divi Form Styler: THE ULTIMATE SOLUTION FOR STYLING YOUR CONTACT FORMS

Transform your form design experience with the Divi Form Styler for Divi Builder. Say goodbye to wrestling with shortcodes and limited customization options. Integrating and styling Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms, or Fluent Forms becomes effortless with our dedicated modules.

Most helpful links

  • DiviEpic Plugins
  • Knowledge Base

KEY FEATURES 💪

  • Contact Form 7 Module: Seamlessly integrate and style your Contact Form 7 forms directly in the Divi Builder. Our dedicated module ensures your contact forms align perfectly with your design.
  • Contact Form 7 Grid Builder: Create beautiful contact form 7 forms with grid builder.
  • Gravity Forms Module: Design and customize Gravity Forms within the Divi Builder interface. Experience seamless design integration without complications.
  • Fluent Forms Module: Enhance Fluent Forms within Divi Builder. Access intuitive tools and design options for comprehensive form customization.
  • User-Friendly Interface: The Divi Form Styler for Divi is intuitive and requires no coding knowledge to create professional-looking forms that enhance your website.

Experience the perfect blend of design and functionality with Divi Form Styler for Divi Builder. Our plugin empowers you to customize forms directly within the Divi builder – no shortcodes, no limitations, just a seamless experience that makes your website stand out.
sections.installation:
Note: This plugin works with Divi. Could you ensure you have Divi Theme installed?

Install the Form Styler for Divi For Divi either via the WordPress plugin directory or by uploading the files to your server at wp-content/plugins.

For more information, please visit our Knowledge Base.
